After your first visit

The first twelve weeks.

Nothing is left to guesswork. Each check-in is booked before you leave, with the same clinician.

00

Day

02

Week

06

Week

12

Week

00

Day one

Your plan begins

Your first treatment happens the same day or within the week. We photograph your skin map in fixed light, so every later photo is a fair comparison.

02

Week two

A check-in, included

A short follow-up with the same clinician. We look at how you settled and adjust a neuromodulator dose if it needs it, at no charge.

06

Week six

Your skin catches up

Collagen and tone treatments take weeks to show. This is usually your second laser or peel session, and when texture starts to change.

12

Week twelve

A new skin map

We photograph your skin again in the same light and angle, compare it with day one and rewrite your plan for the next three months.
